title: 第6章 补充第二卦：化工厂爆炸-《开局三预言？我直播通关S级末世》
content:
第(1/3)页

    天选之人到底是什么，系统并没有回答靳兰玦，它的答复很有神棍风格。

    【时机到了，您自然就知道了。】

    而现在，自己面前的虚空中，又浮现出血红的字体。

    【第二卦补充信息：3日内，西郊化工厂爆炸，死亡人数100+。】

    靳兰玦一愣。

    昨晚，二卦的预言内容分明是与靳泽宇相关的，现在突然变成了西郊化工厂爆炸，说明靳泽宇跟这件灾难的发生脱不了关系。

    私心里，她自然是希望放任预言发生，让靳泽宇得到惨痛的教训。

    但是……

    这次的事故竟然这样严重，化工厂爆炸，会杀死一百多人。

    而且，西郊那个厂子她有点印象。

    去年还因为工业污染的事情闹上过新闻，只是那个厂子的厂长后台很硬，这件事就不了了之了。

    如果这个化工厂爆炸，万一再泄露点什么有害的物质，伤亡数量只会更加恐怖。

    她不再犹豫，快速赶回家开播。

    刚开启直播，就刷刷刷进来上千人，弹幕里已经热热热闹闹开始刷屏。

    同时，还有更多的观众互相转发链接通知，短短五分钟，直播间里面的在线人数已经达到了一百多万。

    平台一看她的数据，立刻将她的直播间放在了直播首页最大的推荐位上面。

    看着还在飞快上涨的在线人数，靳兰玦终于开口。

    “我算到了第二卦的详细信息。

    三日内，西郊化工厂会发生爆炸，伤亡人数超过一百。”

    此话一出，直播间瞬间炸锅。

    【化工厂？我靠这么严重的事故？哪个城市啊？】

    【大师别吓我！我家就在化工厂附近啊啊啊！】

    【不可能吧，上一卦会应验说不定有什么猫腻，事发电梯就在博主家隔壁，说不定她就是早知道会发生什么呢】

    【这还说啥了，赶紧报警啊！！！】

    靳兰玦却不再多说，直接关闭了直播。

    看着自己缓缓上涨的个人影响力就知道，自会有网友将她的预言内容传播到各大平台。

    比起阻止化工厂爆炸，她更想去调查一下靳泽宇，到底做了什么，会引起爆炸这样严重的灾难。

    *

    DMF特战队会议室。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The system did not answer Jin Lanjue’s question as to what the Chosen One is. Its answer was very much like a stickman.

【When the time comes, you will know it naturally.】

And now, blood-red fonts appeared in the void in front of him.

[Additional information for the second hexagram: Within 3 days, a chemical plant in the western suburbs exploded, killing more than 100 people.】

Jin Lanjue was stunned.

Last night, the prophecy of the second hexagram was clearly related to Jin Zeyu, and now it suddenly turned into an explosion at the western suburbs chemical plant, which shows that Jin Zeyu is inseparable from the occurrence of this disaster.

Privately, she naturally hopes to let the prophecy happen and let Jin Zeyu learn a painful lesson.

But...

This accident is so serious. An explosion in a chemical plant will kill more than a hundred people.

“ Moreover, she has some impressions of the factory in the western suburbs.

Last year, the issue of industrial pollution made news, but the director of that factory had a very tough background, so the matter was dropped.

If this chemical plant explodes and any harmful substances are leaked, the number of casualties will only be more terrifying.

She no longer hesitated and rushed home to start broadcasting.

As soon as the live broadcast started, thousands of people came in, and the barrage started to fill the screen with excitement.

At the same time, more viewers forwarded link notifications to each other. In just five minutes, the number of people online in the live broadcast room reached more than one million.

As soon as the platform looked at her data, her live broadcast room was immediately placed on the top recommendation spot on the live broadcast homepage.

Looking at the rapidly increasing number of people online, Jin Lanjue finally spoke.

“I figured out the details of the second hexagram.

Within three days, an explosion will occur at the Xijiao Chemical Plant, with more than 100 casualties."

As soon as these words came out, the live broadcast room exploded instantly.

【Chemical plant?I rely on such a serious accident?Which city?】

【Master, don’t scare me!My home is near a chemical factory!】

"It's impossible. The last hexagram will come true. Maybe there's something fishy about it. The elevator where the incident happened is right next door to the blogger's house. Maybe she just knew what would happen."

【What else is there to say? Hurry up and call the police!!!】

Jin Lanjue said no more and turned off the live broadcast.

Looking at her slowly rising personal influence, I know that there will be netizens who will spread her predictions to major platforms.

Rather than preventing the chemical plant from exploding, she wanted to investigate what Jin Zeyu had done to cause such a serious disaster.

*

DMF special team conference room.
